throughline.zh: 已刊兩天的重點涵蓋越南貿易協定、台灣在日本的晶圓與設備布局、汽車設備股權交易，以及東南亞電子外銷與台灣能源工程。
throughline.en: The two published days cover Vietnam’s trade agreement, Taiwanese wafer/equipment projects in Japan, an automotive-equipment equity transaction, Southeast Asian electronics exports and Taiwanese energy projects.

title.zh: 越南與 EFTA 簽署協定，設備與投資規則待對照生效條件
title.en: Vietnam–EFTA signature sets out equipment and investment rules, subject to effective terms

summary.zh: 越南與 EFTA 四國 10/18 在河內簽署協定，涵蓋貨品、服務、投資、原產地及政府採購。工業設備與電機是既有貿易項目，生效日期和逐項產品待遇尚不能僅由簽署公告認定。
summary.en: Vietnam and the four EFTA states signed in Hanoi on October 18, covering goods, services, investment, origin and procurement. Machinery and electrical goods are established trade categories, while effective dates and product treatment cannot be established from signature alone.

title.zh: 熊本晶圓計畫核准與在地設備服務收購授權
title.en: Kumamoto fab approval and local equipment-service acquisition authorization

summary.zh: 據專業報導，日本 10/16 核准 JASM 二廠首階段 3 奈米計畫，台灣光罩同日改由母公司擬收購 TCK。晶圓產能仍為建置規劃，設備服務收購尚未確認交割，原始核准文件與公告取得範圍有限。
summary.en: Professional reports describe Japan’s October 16 approval of JASM’s initial 3nm phase, while Taiwan Mask changed the proposed TCK buyer to the parent. Wafer capacity remains planned and the acquisition has no confirmed closing, with limited direct access to the underlying approval and filing.

title.zh: 鴻海擬取得三菱電機移動半數股權，合作涵蓋電動動力與控制
title.en: Foxconn’s proposed half-stake in Mitsubishi Electric Mobility covers powertrains and control

summary.zh: 10/16 協議將 50% 股權對價定為 1,150 億日圓，標的全部股權價值為 2,300 億日圓。預定 2027/10/1 交割，仍待核准及契約條件；公告未提供新增出貨或工廠產量。
summary.en: The October 16 agreement sets ¥115 billion for 50%, against total equity value of ¥230 billion. Closing is planned for October 1, 2027 subject to approvals and conditions, without incremental shipments or factory-output figures.

title.zh: 台灣儲能合作、燃料調度與風電工程各有不同完成節點
title.en: Taiwanese storage, fuel logistics and wind works have separate completion milestones

summary.zh: 鴻海團隊 10/16 公布 306 kWh 表後儲能櫃規劃與 2027 上半年供貨目標，經部 10/18 稱中油已展開次年首季採購。離岸二期累計四部完成安裝為經部轉述，尚未等同併網，聯貸付款爭議也未有最終清償安排。
summary.en: Foxconn’s partners announced a planned 306 kWh cabinet and H1 2027 supply target on October 16; MOEA said October 18 that CPC began next-quarter fuel procurement. Four installed offshore turbines are a reported official figure, distinct from grid connection or a final loan-repayment settlement.

title.zh: 新加坡電子外銷與馬來西亞晶片發表分屬出貨及開發資料
title.en: Singapore electronics exports and Malaysian chip launches describe shipments and development

summary.zh: 新加坡 10/16 公布 9 月 NODX 年增 68.4%、對台年增 96.9%，總體增幅包含船體低基期因素。馬來西亞同日發表六項本土晶片創新，3 億令吉銷售潛力無明確期間，發表場館記載亦有差異。
summary.en: Singapore reported September NODX growth of 68.4% and Taiwan-bound growth of 96.9% on October 16, with ship-structure base effects in the aggregate. Malaysia launched six domestic innovations the same day; RM300 million sales potential lacks a period, and launch-venue reports differ.
